mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1's 1-year rolling correlation with SPX falls below 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, labor market tightness increases, driving up wages and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies adapt to new labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with UNRATE below 4%, or the 1-year rolling correlation between UNRATE and SPX wage-sensitive sectors falls below 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) growth rate is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting the overall health of the US economy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 1-year rolling correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns falls below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when both Housing Starts (HOUST) and Retail Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% YoY, the combined effect signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with both HOUST and RSAFS increasing by more than 5% YoY, or the 1-year rolling correlation between the two series falls below 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a monetary easing cycle, a 1% decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as decreased borrowing costs stimulate economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window in easing cycles, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) growth rate is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting the overall health of the US labor market.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 1-year rolling correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX returns falls below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth rate exceeds 2% QoQ, the combined effect signals strong inflationary pressures and decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with both CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 exceeding the specified growth rates, or the 1-year rolling correlation between the two series falls below 0.2.
